name: Paulami Sengupta

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Paulami Sengupta is a Kolkata-based poet, editor and translator who writes in English and Bengali. Her Bengali collection Bayosandhir Haraf appeared under the pen name Anjashi in 2021; her first English collection, Maximum Love in Patel Nagar, followed in 2023. Her work finds unexpected emotional pressure in ordinary rooms, objects and encounters.

‘Two Parts’ begins by taking the word ‘self-doubt’ apart, then moves through a crowded train, remembered loss, detergent and garden scissors. These abrupt turns make anxiety tangible without settling it into a neat explanation. The poem’s everyday objects become ways of approaching feelings that resist being tidied away.
